Roast 190 °C 60–70 min, basting twice, until skin is crisp and core 80 °C (2500 g → ≈ 1800 g chicken).
Finish pan juices with butter; spoon over to serve.

b01b77cb.yl: Yield: 10 portions · Portion: ≈ 400 g (1 leg + pasta)
c: Brown seasoned legs in oil; remove. Sweat onion and garlic; add paste; deglaze with wine.
Add tomatoes, spices, chicken; braise covered 45 min (core 80 °C; 2500 → ≈ 1700 g).
Lift chicken out; add hot water; bring to the boil; add hilopites; cook 12–15 min stirring until absorbed (500 → ≈ 1250 g).
Return chicken; rest 5 min; serve with grated kefalotyri.
b01b77cb.st: 0–4 °C, 48 h; reheat with a little water to 75 °C.

ea515edd.yl: Yield: 10 portions · Portion: 300 g (≈ 5 rolls + sauce)
c: Mix minces, raw rice, grated onion, chopped herbs, oil, salt and pepper; knead 2 min.
Whisk eggs to foam; whisk in starch, then lemon.
Temper with 4 ladles of hot cooking liquid, whisking constantly.
Stir back into the pot off the heat; shake pan gently over low heat until thickened (≤ 80 °C, never boil).
Core cabbage; blanch whole heads, peeling off leaves as they soften; cut out thick ribs (2500 → ≈ 1500 g leaves).
Roll 30 g filling in each leaf piece, sides tucked; pack tightly, seam down, over a layer of trimmings.
Cover with hot stock and butter; weigh down with a plate; simmer 50 min, core ≥ 75 °C.
Make avgolemono with the cooking liquid; pour over off the heat; shake gently to thicken.
ea515edd.st: Hot hold 63–75 °C, 2 h (do not boil). 0–4 °C, 3 days.

439cc032.yl: Yield: 10 portions · Portion: 350 g (110 g cooked lamb)
c: Batch · lamb 1800 g raw → ≈ 1100 g cooked
Cut boned shoulder into 4 cm pieces; brown in oil; add onion, garlic, paste.
Deglaze with wine; add tomatoes, spices, water; braise covered 1 h 30 min.
Transfer lamb and sauce to a clay or deep tray; stir in raw orzo and hot water; season.
Bake 180 °C 30–35 min, stirring once, until orzo is tender and saucy (600 g → ≈ 1500 g).
Rest 5 min; serve topped with grated kefalotyri.
439cc032.st: 0–4 °C, 48 h (reheat with a splash of water to 75 °C).

5a5b6549.yl: Yield: 10 portions · Portion: ≈ 350 g (150 g cooked lamb)
c: Cut lamb into 10 pieces on the bone (≈ 300 g); marinate with garlic, lemon, oil, wine, oregano, salt 12 h.
Make 10 parchment-and-foil parcels: potato wedges, onion, pepper, tomato, lamb, cheese cubes, rosemary, marinade.
Seal tightly; bake 160 °C 3 h 30 min (lamb falls from the bone; 3000 g bone-in → ≈ 1500 g meat).
Open parcels for the last 15 min at 200 °C to colour; serve in the parcel.
5a5b6549.st: Cooked: 0–4 °C, 3 days; reheat sealed 160 °C 30 min to 75 °C.

b5a852f7.yl: Yield: 10 portions · Portion: 280 g (120 g cooked beef)
c: Cut beef into 5 cm pieces; sear in oil; add diced onion and garlic 5 min; paste 1 min.
Deglaze with wine; add tomatoes, water, spices, sugar.
Braise covered 160 °C 2 h 30 min until tender (1800 → ≈ 1200 g); reduce sauce.
Serve with Kritharaki, pilafi, mash or spaghetti (own TTKs).

db36770b.yl: Yield: 1 GN 1/1 tray (65 mm) · 10 portions · Portion: 370 g
c: Salt the aubergine slices, leave 20 min, rinse and pat dry.
Brush the aubergine and courgette with the oil; roast in a convection oven at 200 °C for 10–12 min.
Blanch the potato slices for 5 min in boiling water; drain and dry.
Sweat the onion and garlic in the oil until translucent.
Add the mince and brown, breaking it up.
Add the wine and reduce; add the tomatoes, tomato paste, cinnamon, oregano, bay, salt and pepper.
Simmer on low heat for 20–25 min until thick. Remove the bay leaf.
Melt the butter, add the flour and cook a pale roux for 1–2 min.
Whisk in the hot milk gradually; simmer 5–7 min until thick.
Off the heat cool to about 70 °C, then whisk in the eggs, nutmeg, salt and half the parmesan.
Layer in a greased GN 1/1 (65 mm): potatoes, then aubergine and courgette, then the meat sauce.
Spread the béchamel evenly and sprinkle with the remaining parmesan.
Bake in a convection oven at 170 °C for 40–45 min until golden, to a core temperature of 75 °C.
Rest 15 min before cutting into 10 portions.
Serve one 370 g square, hot, with Greek salad or bread.
db36770b.st: Cool from 63 °C to 10 °C within 2 h, then 0–4 °C covered: 72 h. Frozen at −18 °C: 2 months; thaw at 0–4 °C. Reheat in a convection oven at 160 °C for 20–25 min to a core temperature of ≥75 °C.

7646f884.yl: Yield: 10 portions · Portion: 4 cutlets ≈ 155 g cooked (200 g raw)
c: Marinate cutlets with oil, half the lemon juice, garlic, oregano, rosemary 2–4 h at 4 °C.
Salt just before grilling; grill very hot 2–3 min per side (pink, core 58–60 °C; 2000 g → ≈ 1450 g).
Rest 3 min; squeeze remaining lemon over; serve with lemon wedges and Greek Lemon Potatoes (own TTK).
7646f884.st: Marinated raw: 0–4 °C, 24 h. Grill to order.

c: Batch · 10 aubergines 2500 g → ≈ 1600 g roasted shells
Halve aubergines lengthways; score flesh; salt 20 min; pat dry.
Brush with oil; roast 200 °C 25 min until soft; press the flesh down to form a boat (keep scooped flesh for the filling).
Brown mince; add onion, garlic, chopped scooped aubergine 5 min; wine; tomatoes and cinnamon; simmer 30 min until thick; add parsley.
Cook butter and flour 2 min; whisk in hot milk; simmer 5 min; off the heat add yolks, cheese and nutmeg.
Fill each boat with 55 g meat; cover with 37 g béchamel; sprinkle cheese.
Bake 190 °C 25–30 min until golden, core 75 °C. Rest 10 min.
14ff6e01.al: 1 Gluten (wheat flour) · 3 Eggs (egg yolks) · 7 Milk (milk 3%, butter, kefalotyri) · 14 Sulphites (red wine)

01ed736d.yl: Yield: 10 portions · Portion: 450 g (meat 130 g + pasta 185 g + sauce)
c: Cut veal into 10 portions; rub with garlic, paprika, salt and pepper; marinate in vinegar 2 h at 4 °C.
Brown in oil; add onion 8 min, paste 1 min; deglaze with wine.
Add tomatoes, spices, sugar and 800 g water; braise covered 160 °C 2 h until very tender, core ≥ 75 °C (2000 → ≈ 1300 g).
Boil bucatini 10 min (800 → ≈ 1850 g); toss with sauce; serve with meat and grated kefalotyri.
01ed736d.al: 1 Gluten (bucatini no. 2) · 7 Milk (kefalotyri) · 14 Sulphites (red wine, red wine vinegar)

c: Brown mince hard in oil; add onion and garlic 5 min.
Deglaze with wine; add passata, paste and spices; simmer 45 min until thick (no liquid).
Cook butter and flour 2 min; whisk in hot milk; simmer 5 min until thick.
Off the heat whisk in yolks, cheese, nutmeg and salt.
Cook pasta 2 min under al dente (500 g → ≈ 1150 g); drain; toss with butter, egg whites and half the cheese.
In a 30 × 40 tray: half pasta (packed straight), all ragù, rest of pasta, then béchamel; sprinkle remaining cheese.
Bake 180 °C 45–50 min to deep golden, core 75 °C.
Rest 30 min before cutting into 10 portions.
5a2f8ad9.st: Baked: 0–4 °C, 3 days; reheat 160 °C 25 min to 75 °C. −18 °C, 2 months.
5a2f8ad9.al: 1 Gluten (wheat flour, bucatini no. 2) · 3 Eggs (egg yolks, egg whites) · 7 Milk (milk 3%, butter, kefalotyri) · 14 Sulphites (red wine)

a5cf8e50.yl: Yield: 10 portions · Portion: 380 g (1 pepper + potatoes)
c: Cut caps off 10 large peppers; remove seeds (1500 → ≈ 1300 g).
Brown mince with onion in half the oil; add grated tomato, rice, herbs, salt and pepper; cook 5 min; cool.
Fill peppers ¾; replace caps; stand in a tray with potato wedges between.
Pour over passata, water and remaining oil; bake covered 180 °C 50 min, uncovered 25 min, core ≥ 75 °C.

65d82afe.yl: Yield: 10 portions · Portion: 1 pita ≈ 335 g (140 g cooked pork)
c: Batch · pork 2000 g raw → ≈ 1400 g cooked
Slice pork 5 mm thin; marinate with grated onion, garlic, oil, vinegar, lemon and spices 12 h at 4 °C.
Stack tightly on a skewer (or layer in a loaf tin); roast 180 °C 1 h 30 min to core 75 °C; rest 15 min.
Shave thin; crisp shavings on the flat-top 1 min before serving.
Grate cucumber, salt lightly, squeeze dry in a cloth.
Mix with yoghurt, grated garlic, oil, vinegar and chopped dill; chill 1 h.
Brush and warm pitas on the grill 30 s per side.
Fill each: 60 g tzatziki, 140 g gyros, 40 g tomato wedges, 15 g sliced onion, pinch paprika.
Wrap in paper; serve with Greek Fries (own TTK).
65d82afe.st: Cooked gyros: 0–4 °C, 3 days; reheat on flat-top to 75 °C. Tzatziki: 0–4 °C, 3 days.
65d82afe.al: 1 Gluten (pita bread) · 7 Milk (greek yoghurt 10%) · 14 Sulphites (red wine vinegar)

ad692b1c.yl: Yield: 10 portions (20 skewers) · Portion: 520 g (2 skewers)
c: Batch · Yield ≈ 1500 g grilled (20 skewers × 75 g)
Day before: mix pork with oil, crushed garlic, oregano, pepper and wine; cover, 0–4 °C, up to 24 h.
2–4 h before service add lemon juice (50 g; keep 20 g for basting).
Salt just before grilling; thread 5–6 cubes (100 g raw) per soaked skewer, fat and lean alternating.
Charcoal grill, high direct heat, 8–10 min, turning every 2 min; baste with lemon juice at the end; core 65–68 °C, rest 2–3 min.
Grate cucumber, salt, leave 15 min, squeeze dry.
Mix yoghurt, cucumber, crushed garlic, oil, vinegar and chopped dill; season.
Chill min 1 h at 0–4 °C before service.
Brush pita with oil, grill 30–40 s per side.
Fries at 175 °C to golden, season with salt and oregano.
Plate: pita, 2 skewers, fries, tomato wedges, red onion with parsley, tzatziki 80 g with paprika, lemon wedge.
ad692b1c.st: Marinated pork (no lemon): 0–4 °C, 24 h. With lemon: max 4 h. Grilled skewers: serve immediately. Tzatziki: 0–4 °C, 48 h.
ad692b1c.al: 1 Gluten (pita bread) · 7 Milk (strained yoghurt 10%) · 14 Sulphites (white wine, red wine vinegar). Pita: check label (6, 11).

d4a6626f.yl: Yield: 10 portions · Portion: ≈ 190 g (140 g cooked veal + sauce)
c: Slice veal 1 cm (10 × 180 g); season; dust with flour; sear 1 min per side in oil; layer in a pan.
Scatter sliced garlic and half the parsley; add vinegar, wine and water.
Simmer covered 50–60 min until tender and the sauce is creamy (1800 → ≈ 1400 g).
Finish with parsley; serve with mash or rice (own TTKs).
d4a6626f.al: 1 Gluten (wheat flour) · 14 Sulphites (white wine vinegar, white wine)

9ac35287.yl: Yield: 10 portions · Portion: 220 g (4 pcs + sauce, 120 g raw meat)
c: Soak bread in wine; squeeze; knead with mince, garlic, cumin, egg, parsley and seasoning 3 min; rest 1 h.
Shape 40 oval 'sausages' × 38 g; dust with flour.
Brown in oil 4 min (or bake 220 °C 10 min).
Sweat garlic in oil; add passata, cinnamon, bay, cumin, sugar; simmer 15 min.
Simmer meatballs in the sauce 20 min (core 75 °C); remove cinnamon and bay.
Serve with rice pilaf or mash (own TTKs).
9ac35287.al: 1 Gluten (white bread, wheat flour) · 3 Eggs (eggs) · 14 Sulphites (red wine)

c: Slice sausage 2 cm; brown in a dry pan 6 min (1200 → ≈ 1000 g); remove.
Fry pepper and onion strips in oil 10 min until soft; add garlic; deglaze with wine.
Add tomatoes, oregano, chilli and sausage; simmer 20 min until thick, core ≥ 75 °C.
743b70ab.al: 14 Sulphites (red wine). Sausage: check supplier label (may contain mustard, celery, sulphites).

563f9094.yl: Yield: 10 portions · Portion: ½ lobster + 80 g dry pasta ≈ 480 g
c: Chill lobsters 30 min, kill humanely with a knife through the head; split lengthways; crack claws.
Sear flesh-side in oil 2 min; flambé with cognac; remove.
Garlic and chilli 30 s; paste 1 min; wine; add tomatoes; simmer 15 min, pressing heads into the sauce.
Cook spaghetti 2 min under al dente (800 → ≈ 1850 g); finish in sauce with lobster 3 min, core ≥ 63 °C; butter and parsley.
563f9094.st: Live lobster: 2–6 °C, damp cloth, 24 h. Cook to order.
563f9094.al: 1 Gluten (spaghetti) · 2 Crustaceans (spiny lobster) · 7 Milk (butter) · 14 Sulphites (white wine)

4db13a80.yl: Yield: 10 portions · Portion: ≈ 250 g (160 g fried cod + 90 g skordalia)
c: Batch · potatoes 800 g → riced ≈ 680 g · Yield ≈ 950 g
Boil potatoes in skins; peel and rice hot (800 → ≈ 680 g).
Pound garlic with salt to a paste; beat into the potato with oil and vinegar alternately; loosen with warm water.
Use cod soaked 48 h (water changed 4 times); skin, bone, cut 10 × 150 g; dry well.
Whisk flour, baking powder and ice-cold sparkling water to a thick batter (no salt).
Dip cod; fry 175 °C 5–6 min until golden, core 63 °C.
Serve with 90 g skordalia and lemon; beetroot salad traditional on the side.
Plate cod on a quenelle of skordalia; serve at once.
4db13a80.al: 1 Gluten (wheat flour) · 4 Fish (salt cod) · 14 Sulphites (red wine vinegar)

2496fc2d.yl: Yield: 10 portions · Portion: ≈ 230 g (130 g cooked fish)
c: Sweat sliced onion in oil 10 min until soft; add paprika, cayenne and paste 1 min (do not burn).
Add tomatoes and water; simmer 10 min.
Lay in salted fish portions (10 × 160 g); cover; poach 10–12 min, shaking the pan (core 63 °C; 1600 → ≈ 1300 g).
Finish with lemon; serve with bread.
2496fc2d.st: Sauce: 0–4 °C, 4 days. Fish cooked to order.

c: Sauté prawns in half the oil 1 min; flambé with ouzo; remove.
Sweat onion and garlic in remaining oil; add orzo, toast 2 min; add tomatoes, hot stock and chilli; simmer 5 min.
Transfer to a gastro tray; bake 190 °C 15 min until orzo is just tender (600 → ≈ 1500 g).
Fold in prawns (1000 → ≈ 800 g); crumble feta on top; bake 5 min more, prawns core ≥ 63 °C. Finish with parsley.
fe01deb9.st: Serve within 1 h. Do not reheat prawns twice.
fe01deb9.al: 1 Gluten (orzo) · 2 Crustaceans (shrimp) · 4 Fish (fish stock) · 7 Milk (feta) · 9 Celery (fish stock)

f64c5c37.yl: Yield: 10 portions · Portion: ≈ 240 g (100 g cooked prawns)
c: Sweat onion, pepper and garlic in oil 5 min; add tomatoes and chilli; simmer 15 min to a thick sauce.
Sear prawns in a hot pan 1 min; flame with ouzo; add wine, reduce by half.
Combine with the sauce in individual pans; crumble feta on top.
Bake 220 °C 6–8 min until feta softens (prawns core 63 °C; 1200 g → ≈ 1000 g); finish with parsley; serve with bread.
f64c5c37.st: Sauce: 0–4 °C, 4 days. Prawns cooked to order.
f64c5c37.al: 2 Crustaceans (black tiger prawns) · 7 Milk (feta) · 14 Sulphites (white wine)

c83a5ec1.yl: Yield: 10 portions · Portion: 80 g dry pasta + 2 prawns ≈ 390 g
c: Devein prawns through the shell; sear in oil 1 min each side; flambé with ouzo; remove.
In the same pan, garlic and chilli 30 s; paste 1 min; wine; add tomatoes; simmer 15 min (press the prawn heads into the sauce).
Cook spaghetti 2 min under al dente (800 → ≈ 1850 g); finish in the sauce with prawns 2 min, prawns core ≥ 63 °C.
Toss in butter and parsley; plate with 2 prawns each.
c83a5ec1.st: Sauce base: 0–4 °C, 3 days. Cook to order.
c83a5ec1.al: 1 Gluten (spaghetti) · 2 Crustaceans (tiger prawns) · 7 Milk (butter) · 14 Sulphites (white wine)

c: Pinch off heads and gut; rinse; drain well (1800 → ≈ 1400 g).
Salt; toss in flour; shake off excess.
Fry in fans of 5–6 at 180 °C 2 min until crisp.
Drain; serve at once with lemon.
9ec3bc73.st: Raw: 0–2 °C, same day. Fry to order.

8c858d32.yl: Yield: 10 portions · Portion: ≈ 240 g (110 g cooked octopus)
c: Cook octopus in a dry covered pot 20 min in its own juices; cut into 4 cm pieces; keep the liquid.
Brown pearl onions in oil; add octopus, paste; deglaze with wine and vinegar.
Add tomatoes, spices, sugar and octopus liquid; simmer covered 50–60 min until tender (2500 → ≈ 1100 g).
Reduce to a glossy sauce; no salt needed usually (taste).
8c858d32.al: 12 Molluscs (octopus) · 14 Sulphites (red wine, red wine vinegar)

c: Cook octopus in its own juices, covered, 40 min; cut into 3 cm pieces; keep liquid (2000 → ≈ 1100 g).
Sweat onion and garlic in oil; paste 1 min; deglaze with wine; add tomatoes, spices, octopus and its liquid; simmer 20 min.
Add hot water and pasta; simmer 12 min, stirring, until tender and saucy (700 → ≈ 1700 g).
Rest 5 min; finish with parsley and oil.
Chop tentacles; sauté with onion and garlic in half the oil 5 min; add rice, herbs, raisins, salt and pepper; cool.
Fill tubes ⅔ (rice swells); close with a toothpick.
Sear tubes in remaining oil 1 min; add wine, then tomatoes; braise covered 160 °C 50 min until tender (1500 → ≈ 1000 g).
Rest 10 min; slice or serve whole with the sauce.

2810f69f.yl: Yield: 10 portions · Portion: ≈ 225 g (130 g cooked fish)
c: Whisk oil, lemon, oregano and salt to an emulsion; add chopped parsley just before service.
Batch · spinach 1200 g → ≈ 600 g · Yield ≈ 650 g
Blanch greens in salted boiling water 1–2 min; drain well.
Dress warm with oil, lemon and salt.
Score skin; oil and season fillets (10 × 160 g).
Grill or plancha skin-side down 3–4 min until crisp; turn 1 min (core 60 °C; 1600 g → ≈ 1300 g).
Plate on horta; spoon 30 g ladolemono over.
2810f69f.st: Ladolemono: 0–4 °C, 3 days (herbs added fresh). Fish cooked to order.

c: Rinse fish; gut if larger than 8 cm; drain well and pat dry.
Salt; toss in flour; shake off excess in a sieve.
Fry in small batches at 180 °C 2–3 min until crisp (1800 → ≈ 1400 g).
Drain; salt; serve at once with lemon wedges.
857756b0.st: Raw: 0–2 °C, same day. Fried: serve within 15 min.

c: Batch · in shell 2000 g → ≈ 400 g meat + 450 g liquor
Debeard and scrub; discard open ones that don't close.
Steam with wine covered 4 min until open; discard closed ones.
Pick meat; strain liquor through a cloth.
Sweat onions and garlic in oil 6 min; add rice, toast 2 min.
Add tomatoes, mussel liquor and hot stock; cover; cook on low heat 15 min (600 → ≈ 1700 g).
Fold in mussel meat and herbs; rest covered 5 min; finish with lemon.
14c9472f.st: Serve within 1 h. Chill fast; 0–4 °C, 24 h.
14c9472f.al: 4 Fish (fish stock) · 9 Celery (fish stock) · 12 Molluscs (mussels) · 14 Sulphites (white wine)

029ab6ee.yl: Yield: 10 portions · Portion: 270 g (fish 130 g cooked + sauce)
c: Cook grated fresh and canned tomato with garlic, half the oil, wine and sugar 15 min; add half the parsley; season.
Season fillets; lay skin-down in an oiled tray; cover with sauce.
Mix crumbs with remaining parsley and oil; sprinkle over.
Bake 200 °C 15–18 min until golden, fish core ≥ 63 °C (1600 → ≈ 1300 g).
029ab6ee.st: Sauce: 0–4 °C, 3 days. Baked: serve within 1 h.
029ab6ee.al: 1 Gluten (breadcrumbs) · 4 Fish (sea bass fillet) · 14 Sulphites (white wine)

312ed5b0.yl: Yield: 10 portions · Portion: ≈ 240 g (130 g cooked fish)
c: Sweat sliced onion and garlic in oil 10 min until soft and sweet.
Add paste, wine, tomatoes, sugar, oregano; simmer 15 min; add half the parsley.
Season hake portions (10 × 160 g) with salt and lemon; lay on half the sauce in a tray; cover with the rest.
Bake 190 °C 18–20 min to core 63 °C (1600 g → ≈ 1300 g).
Finish with parsley; serve with bread or boiled potatoes.

7bb06ddb.yl: Yield: 10 portions · Portion: 200 g (fillet 180 g + ladolemono)
c: Mix coarse salt, egg whites and water to wet sand.
Fill cavities with lemon slices, thyme and bay; do not scale.
Lay on 1 cm salt; cover fully with crust 1 cm thick.
Crack crust at table or pass; lift off skin; fillet.
Whisk oil, lemon and oregano (ladolemono); spoon over fillets.
7bb06ddb.al: 3 Eggs (egg whites) · 4 Fish (sea bass). Egg white only in the salt crust (not eaten).

c: Pat sardines dry; brush with oil; salt.
Grill skin-side down on a very hot grill 2 min; turn 1 min (1500 → ≈ 1200 g).
Dress with oil, lemon, garlic, oregano and parsley; serve with lemon wedges.

7e9fa909.yl: Yield: 10 portions · Portion: ≈ 240 g (100 g cooked cuttlefish)
c: Cut cuttlefish into 3 cm strips; sauté in oil until liquid evaporates.
Add onions 5 min; deglaze with wine; add water; simmer covered 40–50 min until tender (1800 → ≈ 1000 g).
Add chopped spinach and dill; cook 8 min until wilted and saucy.

ae8de663.yl: Yield: 10 portions · Portion: 1 fish ≈ 360 g whole (≈ 180 g edible)
c: Whisk oil, lemon, oregano and salt; add parsley before service.
Scale and gut 10 bream × 400 g; score twice each side; oil and salt inside and out.
Grill 6–7 min per side over medium-high heat (fish basket) until the dorsal fin pulls out easily, core 60 °C.
Serve whole with 22 g ladolemono and lemon; fillet at the table on request.

cf77789b.yl: Yield: 10 portions · Portion: 300 g (2 artichoke hearts)
c: Sweat onions in oil 5 min; add potatoes (4 cm), carrots (2 cm) and water; simmer 10 min.
Add artichoke hearts, half the dill, salt; simmer covered 20 min.
Mix starch with lemon juice; stir in; shake pan 2 min to a light velvety sauce; finish with dill.
Sweat onions in oil 6 min; add potatoes (3 cm) and carrots (1 cm rounds) 3 min.
Add tomatoes, water, sugar, salt; simmer 15 min.
Add peas and dill; simmer 15 min until vegetables are soft and sauce thick.
Trim okra caps without cutting into the pod; toss with vinegar and a little salt; sun- or air-dry 1 h (prevents sliminess); rinse.
Sweat onion and garlic in oil 6 min; add paste, tomatoes, water, sugar; simmer 10 min.
Add okra; shake (do not stir); simmer covered 30–35 min or bake 180 °C 40 min until tender.
Slice courgettes and peeled potatoes 5 mm; salt courgettes and drain 20 min.
Layer in an oiled tray: potato, courgette, crumbled cheeses, mint, pepper, flour; repeat 3 times, ending with cheese.
Pour over water and remaining oil.
Bake covered 180 °C 50 min; uncover 20 min until golden and potatoes are soft; rest 15 min.
Cut potatoes 1 cm slices; courgettes and aubergines 1.5 cm rounds; peppers and onion in strips.
Grate tomatoes (discard skins); mix with garlic, oil, herbs and seasoning.
Toss everything in a deep tray; add water; cover with foil.
Bake 190 °C 45 min covered, then 45 min uncovered, stirring once, until soft and caramelised (≈ 4900 g raw → 3000 g).
6a02c52f.st: 0–4 °C, 4 days. Serve warm or at room temperature, with feta if wished (not included).

c: Top and tail beans (2000 → ≈ 1850 g); cut potatoes into 3 cm pieces.
Sweat onion and garlic in half the oil 6 min; add paste 1 min.
Add beans, potatoes, tomatoes, water, sugar, seasoning; cover; simmer gently 45–50 min until beans are very soft and the sauce is oily-thick.
Finish with parsley and remaining raw oil.

0e9c6305.yl: Yield: 10 portions · Portion: 1 tomato + 1 pepper + potatoes ≈ 400 g
c: Cut lids off 10 large tomatoes and 10 peppers; scoop tomato pulp and blend (≈ 700 g); salt shells with a pinch of sugar.
Sweat onion and garlic in half the oil; add rice, half the pulp, herbs, seasoning; cook 5 min (rice half-raw).
Fill vegetables ¾ full; replace lids; stand in a tray with potato wedges between them.
Pour over remaining pulp mixed with paste, water and oil; season potatoes.
Bake 180 °C 1 h 15 min (cover the first 40 min) until rice is soft and tops blistered (≈ 5800 g raw → 4000 g).
0e9c6305.st: 0–4 °C, 3 days; reheat 170 °C 20 min. Served warm or at room temperature.

c: Soak beans 24 h; simmer in fresh water with bay 50–60 min until just tender; drain (700 g dry → ≈ 1750 g).
Sweat diced onion, carrot, celery and garlic in half the oil 8 min; add paste, tomatoes, water, sugar; simmer 10 min.
Mix beans with sauce and herbs in a tray; drizzle remaining oil.
Bake 180 °C 50–60 min until the top is caramelised and the sauce thick.

c53907e8.yl: Yield: 10 portions · Portion: ½ aubergine + topping ≈ 270 g
c: Halve aubergines lengthways; score; salt 20 min; dry; fry or roast with 100 g oil until golden and soft.
Sweat sliced onion and garlic in 150 g oil 20 min until very soft; add tomatoes, sugar, parsley; cook 10 min.
Press a hollow in each half; pile topping in; pour over water and remaining oil.
Bake 170 °C 40 min until melting. Serve warm or at room temperature.
Cut cauliflower into large florets (2000 → ≈ 1400 g); brown in half the oil 6 min; remove.
Sweat onion and garlic in remaining oil; add paste; deglaze with wine.
Add tomatoes, spices, sugar and 200 g water; return cauliflower; simmer covered 20 min until tender, not mushy.
Core and shred cabbage coarsely (1500 → ≈ 1200 g).
Sweat onion in oil 6 min; add cabbage; cook 10 min until wilted.
Add paprika, passata, rice and hot water; simmer covered 18 min until rice is soft (300 → ≈ 900 g).
Finish with dill, lemon and seasoning; rest 5 min.
Peel potatoes; cut in 4 cm chunks (2000 → ≈ 1700 g).
Sweat onion in oil 8 min; add garlic, paste and paprika 1 min.
Add potatoes, tomatoes, water, bay and oregano; simmer covered 35 min until tender and the sauce is thick.
Sweat onion and leek in oil 10 min until soft; add paste.
Add rice, hot water, salt; simmer covered 18 min until soft and loose.
Finish with lemon, dill and pepper; rest 5 min.
35ae23a8.st: 0–4 °C, 48 h; reheat with a splash of water to 75 °C.

c: Wash spinach; chop roughly (1500 g wilts to ≈ 800 g).
Sweat onions in half the oil 5 min; add spinach until wilted.
Add rice, hot water, salt; cover; simmer 18–20 min until rice is soft and still loose.
